subject: Physics
source_note: TIE (2023), Physics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Apply knowledge of Physics in various contexts

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts, theories and principles of Physics
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of heat (measurement of temperature, thermal expansion, thermal energy, transfer of thermal energy, measurement of thermal energy, vapour and humidity in relation to air temperature )
(b) Explore the basic tenets of the physics of the atom (structure of atom and structure nuclear, radioactivity, nuclear radiations, nuclear processes and thermionic emission)
(c) Describe the basic principles of electronics (semiconductors, diode, transistor, amplifier)
(d) Describe the concept of renewable energy (solar, hydropower, wind and geothermal energy)

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of heat (measurement of temperature, thermal expansion, thermal energy, transfer of thermal energy, measurement of thermal energy, vapour and humidity in relation to air temperature )
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Experimentation, Demostrations, ICT based learning
objectives.resources: Thermometer, calorimeter, ball and ring, heat source, metal rods and hygrometer
objectives.assessment_criteria: Concepts of heat are explored appropriately

objectives.text: (b) Explore the basic tenets of the physics of the atom (structure of atom and structure nuclear, radioactivity, nuclear radiations, nuclear processes and thermionic emission)
objectives.resources: GM counter, Periodic Table and chart showing radioactive elements
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts and principles related to the Physics of the atom are explored appropriately

objectives.text: (c) Describe the basic principles of electronics (semiconductors, diode, transistor, amplifier)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Scenario, ICT based learning, Experiment
objectives.resources: Periodic Table, online resources, Text books, CRO, Diode, Transistor, AC Voltage Generator and connecting wires
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts of electronics are described correctly

objectives.text: (d) Describe the concept of renewable energy (solar, hydropower, wind and geothermal energy)
objectives.resources: Solar panel, online resources, Charts, wind mill model, batteries, connecting wires and inverters
objectives.assessment_criteria: The concepts of renewable energy are described appropriately

sub_topics.title: Use mathematics to explain physical principles and phenomena
competences: (a) Apply mathematical knowledge to describe various principles and physical phenomena related to heat, physics of the atom, electronics and renewable energy

objectives.text: (a) Apply mathematical knowledge to describe various principles and physical phenomena related to heat, physics of the atom, electronics and renewable energy
objectives.assessment_criteria: Mathematical knowledge to describe various principles and physical phenomena are correctly applied

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic experimental skills in Physics
competences: (a) Carry out scientific investigations related to heat, physics of the atom, electronics and renewable energy

objectives.text: (a) Carry out scientific investigations related to heat, physics of the atom, electronics and renewable energy
objectives.resources: Thermometer, calorimeter, online resources (Simulation) and GM counter
objectives.assessment_criteria: Scientific investigations related to heat, physics of the atom, electronics and renewable energy are analysed appropriately

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of data analysis, presentation and report writing in Physics
competences: (a) Use scientific report to communicate experimental results in Physics

objectives.text: (a) Use scientific report to communicate experimental results in Physics
objectives.assessment_criteria: A scientific report is correctly used to communicate experimental results in Physics

topics.title: Evaluate and use information in Physics

sub_topics.title: Collect, describe and relate physical data
competences: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical parameters (heat, physics of atom, electronics and renewable energy)
(b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to heat, physics of atom, electronics and renewable energy

objectives.text: (a) Collect and analyse data to explain various physical parameters (heat, physics of atom, electronics and renewable energy)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Collected physics data are correctly analysed to explain various physical quantities

objectives.text: (b) Collect and analyse data to explain experimental observations related to heat, physics of atom, electronics and renewable energy
objectives.teaching_methods: Group discussion, Project work, ICT-based learning
objectives.resources: Online resources and other relevant materials
objectives.assessment_criteria: Collected physical data are correctly analysed to explain experimental observations related to heat, physics of atom, electronics and renewable energy

sub_topics.title: Carry out a project in Physics
competences: (a) Complete and submit a report for the research project started in Form III

objectives.text: (a) Complete and submit a report for the research project started in Form III
objectives.teaching_methods: Problem-solving approach, Collaborative Learning, ICT-based learning
objectives.assessment_criteria: Report for the research project started in Form III is completed and submitted
